newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC says proceeding with Siab merger.
newsitem.headline: NCC says proceeding with Siab merger.

text.p: Swedish construction company NCC said on Monday it was starting a merger with rival Siab after receiving the approval of the Swedish competition authorities.

"This will result in the formation of Sweden's largest construction and real estate company, with annual sales of slightly more than 30 billion crowns and more than 20,000 employees," NCC said in a statement.
The new group would be called NCC.
NCC said it had to make some changes to the merger because of competition authority demands, in particular relating to its ballast and asphalt operations.

These changes would result in the sale of the shares in Siab associated companies Swerock and Clifton after they are restructured. In addition NCC said five small, local asphalt plants would be discontinued.
"These commitments affect only a small portion of the acquired operations and do not change the acquisition calculation," NCC President and Chief Executive Jan Sjoqvist said in the statement.
